device.description: 16-bit 500 kSPS unipolar micropower SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface and daisy-chain
device.note: ads8319.pdf (SLAS600C) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions (+VBD 2.375-5.5 V), p.6 logic levels, p.7 timing requirements (tcnv 1400 ns max), p.19 Table 1 output codes (straight binary), p.20 3-wire CS mode without busy indicator (Figure 50)

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.6 (logic levels), p.7 (timing), p.19 (Table 1 output codes), p.20 (3-wire CS mode, Figure 50)
notModeled: analog input and reference (unipolar 0 to VREF, straight binary: the 0 V code is 0000h)
mode selection by the SDI level at the CONVST rising edge: only 3-wire CS mode without busy indicator (SDI tied high, CONVST as CS) is modeled; SDI is not read
4-wire CS mode (SDI as CS), busy-indicator bit (CONVST or SDI low at the end of conversion) and daisy-chain mode (SDI as chain input)
SDO driven while CONVST is low during a conversion (modeled: the frame shows the last result); the datasheet requires CONVST high again before the minimum conversion time
auto power-down after each conversion (no visible bus effect); acquisition time and throughput limits
timing values are the +VBD < 3.1 V (ADS8318) / < 4.5 V (ADS8319) table (ten 22 ns, t3 24 ns, tdis 15 ns); at higher +VBD they are 15/16/12 ns
variants: ADS8319I and ADS8319IB are accuracy grades of the same device; ADS8318 is the bipolar sibling (own datasheet)
